verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a government e-services provider, but the evidence shows no documented batch or bulk capability. Registering several program accounts on one form is a single combined registration, not bulk action across many items. EFILE lets certified software file clients' returns, but nothing in the evidence says it batches many items at once, so both are adjacent features rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
